title: Activity/usage integration; never invent MEASURED
issue_presented: How does Governance V2 connect to Atlas usage tracking without a competing store or fake MEASURED numbers?

known_facts.fact: Atlas_Usage_Tracker SQLite exists; Job 0 MEASURED proof failed; Task 3 usage UNKNOWN with null tokens.
Allowed statuses in tracker code: MEASURED, RECONSTRUCTED, ESTIMATED, UNKNOWN.

analysis: Governance references the usage record. It must not duplicate token ledgers or mint MEASURED.
judgment_rule: Preserve chain: USER INPUT → GOVERNING LAW → AGENT/RUN → SOURCES/EVIDENCE → ACTION → OUTPUT → VALIDATION → USAGE/COST → FINAL STATUS.
Provider-measured usage is MEASURED. Local reconstructed usage is RECONSTRUCTED. Unknown remains UNKNOWN.
Job records store usage.tracker path, measurement_status, and event_id — not a second token warehouse.
operational_effect: atlas_gov.attach_usage writes UNKNOWN unless caller supplies a permitted status and evidence.
